definitions.short: Uriel , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H222. Uriel אוּרִיאֵל proper name, masculine ( flame of El or my light is El , see אֵל below אלה ; compare Phoenician ארמלך in Assyrian Urumilki (Sen Taylor Cylind.ii.50 , compare COT 2Kin 18:13 )) 1 chief of Levitical line of Kohath, in time of David 1Chr 6:9 ; 15:5 , 11 . 2 maternal grandfather of Abijah 2Chr 13:2 .
